work.title: Untitled (Green Floral Figure)
work.description: Layered collage combining a photographic torso fragment at lower center with dense floral imagery rendered in yellow and green over a tan ground. Broad gestural green brushstrokes sweep diagonally across the composition, while a schematic face with drawn eyes appears at the top on a pale blue ground.
work.composition: diagonal sweep with central torso fragment
keywords: layered photograph and paint on paper
